messages:
alex: Hey team — opened PR #4892 that touches /runtime/gateway, /infra/telemetry, and /models/loader. CODEOWNERS lists different owners for each. Who has merge rights here? Need to unblock a canary deploy later today.

mira: Can you paste the changed files or a quick diff summary? If runtime change is small I can approve infra bits, but runtime perf changes need runtime owner review.

alex: Files are: runtime/gateway/client.go (adds enable_prefetch option), models/loader/init.go (tweak init order), infra/telemetry/schema_v2.json (adds optional field). PR: https://git.company/redwood/repo/pull/4892

mira: Looks additive on telemetry from the diff I saw.

jon: According to our CODEOWNERS: /runtime/* -> @runtime-team, /infra/telemetry/* -> @infra-observability, /models/* -> @ml-platform. Cross-area PRs usually require one approval from each owning team. Tagging leads: @sam-runtime @liam-obs.

sam: I can take runtime review today. If telemetry is strictly additive, infra-observability can rubber-stamp. Do we have to split this?

alex: Prefer not to split because e2e tests exercise the whole flow and splitting would block verification. Is there a fast-path / approver override for multi-area PRs?

mira: There is a codeowners-override workflow for urgent patches but it requires two senior engs + eng-platform signoff. Handbook section: https://handbook.internal/redwood/codeowners#override (TL;DR: use sparingly).

jon: This isn't a sev incident, so I'd push for standard approvals. If you need faster, add label `expedite` and @eng-platform will prioritize review routing.

ci-bot: ci/circleci — All checks passed.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll review the runtime diff in ~1h and leave comments.

mira: I'll review the telemetry schema right after. If it's additive-only, I'll approve.

alex: Thanks. @sam @mira if you both approve I'll merge once checks are green. If something blocks, ping me and I can try to get an override with eng-platform.

jon: Also add the canary rollout entry (rollout-configs/) so product can monitor the canary.

alex: Added rollout-configs/entry for the canary to the same PR.

alex: Merge done at 2419807830 — all approvals in, canary started. Thanks everyone!
